notes: Scaffold metrics to be wired into QoLI. Replace placeholders with best-guess estimates + logic + ranges.

violent_crime_rate_index.assumption: Violent crime rate remains influenced by inequality, addiction, and instability.
violent_crime_rate_index.mechanism: Status quo maintains high stress drivers; enforcement remains reactive.
violent_crime_rate_index.rationale: Crime correlates with poverty and instability; improvements are incremental without structural change.

incarceration_burden_index.assumption: Incarceration remains heavily used; private incentives persist (where legal).
incarceration_burden_index.mechanism: Punishment-first systems keep prison populations high.
incarceration_burden_index.rationale: High incarceration imposes community disruption and long-run costs.

community_trust_policing_index.assumption: Trust remains low where policing is not locally accountable.
community_trust_policing_index.mechanism: Opaque discipline and federal posture reduce legitimacy.
community_trust_policing_index.rationale: Legitimacy depends on accountability and proximity.

violent_crime_rate_index.assumption: Early improvements begin via stability: housing/healthcare security reduces crime drivers.
violent_crime_rate_index.mechanism: Prevention systems reduce desperation and addiction harms.
violent_crime_rate_index.rationale: Structural stability reduces root causes; effects start modestly.

incarceration_burden_index.assumption: No private prisons; diversion and restorative pipelines begin.
incarceration_burden_index.mechanism: Shift from incarceration to prevention, treatment, and community accountability.
incarceration_burden_index.rationale: Reducing incarceration lowers long-term social cost and increases family stability.

community_trust_policing_index.assumption: Community-based policing and local control increase legitimacy.
community_trust_policing_index.mechanism: Transparent oversight + local leadership control reduces abuse and increases cooperation.
community_trust_policing_index.rationale: Trust improves when accountability is local and visible.
